parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const count=f=>rows.filter(f).length; const image=count(r=>String(r['تم التحقق من الصورة']||'').toUpperCase()!=='TRUE'); const review=count(r=>String(r['بوابة المراجعة']||'').toUpperCase()!=='PASS'&&String(r['حالة سير العمل']||'').toUpperCase()!=='PUBLISHED'); const publish=count(r=>String(r['بوابة المراجعة']||'').toUpperCase()==='PASS'&&String(r['حالة الجودة']||'').toUpperCase()==='PASS'&&String(r['جاهزية الترقية']||'').toUpperCase()==='PUBLISHED'); const blocked=count(r=>String(r['حالة الجودة']||'').toUpperCase()==='FAIL'||String(r['فحص التكرار']||'').toUpperCase()==='DUPLICATE'); const state={image_processing:image,admin_review:review,publication_ready:publish,blocked,total:rows.length}; const actions=[]; if(image)actions.push('IMAGE_PROCESSING'); if(review)actions.push('ADMIN_APPROVAL'); if(publish)actions.push('CATALOG_SYNC'); if(blocked)actions.push('MANUAL_REVIEW'); return [{json:{event_id:`ORC-${Date.now()}`,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),state,actions,notes:`actions=${actions.join(',')||'NONE'} | total=${rows.length} | image=${image} | review=${review} | publish=${publish} | blocked=${blocked}`}}];
